content.short: WebHash is a no-code platform for creating tokenized, decentralized, and permanent websites.
content.description: WebHash lets anyone create and publish robust websites without coding, delivering a tamper-proof and enduring online presence. Websites are published on IPFS and tokenized on Base, offering enhanced security, immutability, and verifiable ownership. WebHash sets a new standard for website development and management, ensuring your online presence remains secure, resilient, and lasting across Web3, with decentralized hosting and straightforward updates.
